posts.text: While you’re here, check out our new special report on the American Opportunity Agenda. Congress can do more right now to lower the cost of living through another reconciliation bill. We compiled the policies that would get it done: heritage.org/budget-and-spen…

NEW SPECIAL REPORT: Americans need economic relief now—not after the election. Congress should immediately move to pass a third reconciliation bill to enact spending reforms and lower the cost of living.

We call it the American Opportunity Agenda. 👇 heritage.org/budget-and-spen…

Congress needs to immediately move to pass a third reconciliation bill that makes significant reforms to government spending in order to adequately address the prohibitively high cost of living for too many Americans.
Congress can do more to alleviate Americans’ high cost of living. It needs to act now! heritage.org/budget-and-spen…
Here is the game plan to get it done. There is no time to waste! heritage.org/budget-and-spen…

NEXT WEEK: Join Former French presidential candidate and renowned journalist @ZemmourEric for a discussion about the effects of Muslim immigration. As the U.S. grapples with its own questions around immigration, we’ll discuss what lessons can be drawn from France’s approach.

Register here: heritage.org/border-security…

OUT NOW: Higher Education in America: It’s Worse than You Think, edited by Heritage President Dr. Kevin Roberts.

Higher education is in crisis. To capture the full scope of the problem, The Heritage Foundation assembled college presidents, professors, and researchers from across the country to contribute their unique perspectives about the problems plaguing higher education and to offer solutions.

Order your copy today! 👉 a.co/d/0aMuIWzN

The state of higher education in America is worse than you think. 

A new book edited by @KevinRobertsTX draws on insight from college presidents, professors, researchers, and education policy experts to examine the challenges and solutions for higher education.

Learn more about the book in the latest episode of the Heritage Explains podcast with @JM_Butcher, dropping tomorrow! Visit Heritage.org/Heritage-Explai….

Order your book copy here: a.co/d/0h5JtsPl
